breakdown.description: The patch type defined in 'constant/polyMesh/boundary' ('symmetryPlane') conflicts with the boundary condition type specified in the field file '0/U' ('wall'). The types must be consistent across the setup.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It specified the 'frontAndBack' patch type as 'symmetryPlane' in 'constant/polyMesh/boundary' but then set the boundary condition for the same patch to 'type empty;' in the '0/U' field file. A patch of type 'symmetryPlane' requires a corresponding 'symmetryPlane' boundary condition in the field files. The types remain inconsistent.
